objectives.en: Classify debentures by security, tenure, convertibility, coupon and registration

narration.en: A company needs ₹50 crore for a new plant but its owners do not want to share control. It can borrow from the public by issuing debentures.
narration.kn: ಹೊಸ ಘಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ₹50 ಕೋಟಿ ಬೇಕು, ಆದರೆ ಮಾಲೀಕರು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹಂಚಲು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆಗ ಅದು ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ವಿತರಿಸಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಂದ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

body.en: A debenture is a written instrument, issued under the common seal of the company, acknowledging a debt. The holder lends money to the company and earns interest at a fixed rate. Section 2(30) of the Companies Act, 2013 includes debenture stock, bonds and similar instruments.
body.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮುದ್ರೆಯಡಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಲದ ಲಿಖಿತ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರದಾರರು ಸಾಲಗಾರರು; ಅವರಿಗೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ದರದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Interest at a fixed rate, payable even in a loss year
Usually secured by a charge on the company’s assets

narration.en: A debenture is a written acknowledgement of a debt by the company. The debentureholder is a lender who earns a fixed rate of interest.
narration.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮುದ್ರೆಯಡಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಲದ ಲಿಖಿತ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರದಾರರು ಸಾಲಗಾರರು; ಅವರಿಗೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ದರದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Shares vs debentures

narration.en: A shareholder owns the company; a debentureholder lends to it. Compare them row by row.

say.en: A shareholder owns the company; a debentureholder lends to it. Compare them row by row.
Dividend is an appropriation of profit; interest is a charge, payable even in a loss year.
Kaveri Limited has two thousand twelve per cent debentures of one hundred rupees and made a loss.

text.en: Dividend: not compulsory in a loss

prompt.en: Sort each feature: is it true of shares or of debentures?

text.en: Holders are owners of the company
Holders receive dividend, an appropriation of profit
Cannot be issued at a discount (except sweat equity)
Holders are creditors of the company
Holders receive interest, a charge against profit
Usually secured by a charge on assets
May be issued at a discount

explanation.en: Shareholders own the company, vote and get dividends when declared; debentureholders lend to it, get fixed interest whether or not there is profit, and are repaid on maturity, often with security.

body.en: Shareholders are owners and get dividend, an appropriation of profit, only when declared. Debentureholders are creditors and get interest, a charge against profit. Shares cannot be issued at a discount (except sweat equity); debentures can. Debentures are repaid before shares on winding up.
body.kn: ಷೇರುದಾರರು ಮಾಲೀಕರು, ಅವರಿಗೆ ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರದಾರರು ಸಾಲದಾತರು, ಅವರಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಹೊರೆ; ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಲಾಭದ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ.

points.en: Voting rights: shareholders yes, debentureholders no
Discount on issue: not allowed for shares, allowed for debentures

narration.en: Shareholders are owners who receive dividend; debentureholders are creditors who receive interest. Interest is a charge against profit, while dividend is an appropriation of profit.
narration.kn: ಷೇರುದಾರರು ಮಾಲೀಕರು, ಅವರಿಗೆ ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರದಾರರು ಸಾಲದಾತರು, ಅವರಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಹೊರೆ; ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಲಾಭದ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ.

body.en: By security: secured or unsecured. By tenure: redeemable or irredeemable (perpetual). By convertibility: convertible (fully or partly) or non-convertible. By coupon: specific coupon rate or zero coupon. By registration: registered or bearer.
body.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಅವಧಿ, ಪರಿವರ್ತನೀಯತೆ, ಕೂಪನ್ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Debentures are classified by security, tenure, convertibility, coupon rate and registration.
narration.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಅವಧಿ, ಪರಿವರ್ತನೀಯತೆ, ಕೂಪನ್ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Interest comes before profit; a dividend can only come out of what is left.

How much profit before interest is needed just to cover the interest?
Raise the rate to 15%: what happens to profit available for shareholders?

problem.en: Kaveri Ltd. has equity share capital of ₹10,00,000 and 2,000, 12% debentures of ₹100 each. In 2024-25 it made a loss. What must it pay to debentureholders and to shareholders?

steps.en: Interest = 12% of ₹2,00,000 = ₹24,000, a charge that must be paid even in a loss year.
Dividend is an appropriation of profit; with a loss, no dividend need be declared.

answer.en: Debenture interest ₹24,000 must be paid; no dividend is compulsory.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ಸಾಲದ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ; ಅದರ ಧಾರಕ ಸಾಲದಾತ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಲಾಭದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಹೊರೆ; ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಲಾಭದ ವಿನಿಯೋಗ. ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಡಬಹುದು; ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ. ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣದ ಐದು ಆಧಾರಗಳು: ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಅವಧಿ, ಪರಿವರ್ತನೀಯತೆ, ಕೂಪನ್, ನೋಂದಣಿ.
